action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that Moodle did not properly restrict URLs.
An authenticated user could possibly use this issue to perform a
server-side request forgery attack and expose sensitive information.
isummary:
Moodle could be made to expose sensitive information over the
network.
